findings.summary: Focus can be lost when the desktop sidebar becomes hidden at the mobile breakpoint.
findings.fix: Preserve the sidebar focus state before it becomes hidden, then move focus to the visible menu toggle when crossing to mobile.
findings.evidence: The breakpoint handler checks sidebar.contains(document.activeElement) only after the sidebar becomes display:none.

passed: Skip link targets the main element, which has tabindex="-1" and a visible focus style.
Sidebar fragment-link activation closes the mobile menu and focuses the destination.
notes: Assessment was limited to the specified code; breakpoint behavior was not runtime-tested in a browser.
